scientific.integrity: The primary full text was inspected at the model equations, disease-free and endemic equilibria, uniqueness and parameter-monotonicity statements, numerical parameter table, bifurcation discussion, and conclusions. A closely related earlier full text was inspected for the media-feedback mechanism. Exact arithmetic and finite-root replay are bundled; the asymptotic theorem itself is analytic. A later same-author model was identified but its full text was unavailable through the lawful sources checked.
scientific.limitations: The theorem concerns the endemic equilibrium branch. It does not classify the large-feedback periodic attractor after Hopf loss of equilibrium stability, estimate parameters from data, or claim finite-feedback eradication when the disease-free threshold remains above one.

title: A sharp high-media-growth trichotomy for endemic equilibria in a fear–awareness epidemic model
